title: Canonicalize provider-neutral GIMP generative interoperability without duplicating MMG or runtime authorities
decisions: Reuse FA3-MMG-CONTEXT-IR-001 and FA3-MMG-CONTEXT-IR-CONTRACTS-001; do not create a second generation context IR.
Materialize a provider-neutral Creative Desktop to Generative Media interoperability contract for document, layer, selection, mask, alpha, color, generation-intent and result-placement semantics.
Treat GIMP to ComfyUI plugins as replaceable optional adapters and reference implementations, never as workflow, model-registry, resource, security, evidence or orchestration authorities.
Treat nchenevey1/gimp-comfy-tools as a strong functional pattern source but reference-only for code intake under the existing permissive-license admission direction because the repository is GPL-3.0.
Treat ProgrammerDruid/gimp-comfy-ai and Charlweed components as MIT reference candidates subject to security, revision, dependency and runtime admission; no runtime production claim is made.
Require workflow and custom-node revision/hash inventory, model artifact security admission and provider projection loss evidence.
Default result placement is nondestructive; provider or transport failure must not mutate or corrupt the source GIMP document.
Live editor transport is optional and non-authoritative; local operation is supported without a cloud dependency.
